summary: LG Display Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on April 23, 2026, disclosing its Q1 2026 unaudited earnings results under K-IFRS. The filing reports revenues of KRW 5,534 billion, a 23% QoQ decline and 9% YoY decline; operating profit of KRW 146.7 billion, up 338% YoY; and a net loss of KRW 576 billion. The earnings release and conference call details are provided. This is a routine periodic financial report by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. No terms, advisor, or deal mechanics are present. The filing lacks any extraordinary corporate event, so it is classified as 'None'.
